Godly DPS, Ginormous AoE circle and GREAT range. Golden Freezo's huge AoE circle, resulting in huge coverage and a massive amount of enemies being hit at one time makes him one of the best units in the game currently, and truly an "emperor" in terms of his capabilities to do insane amounts of damage. Upon release, he was being compared to Metal Knight (Arsenal), which after further testing, Freezo just barely beats Metal Knight because of his 3 placements contrasting from Metal Knight only having 2, which equates to Freezo having more Group DPS and DPM. Golden Freezo's affinity combo is also really good because it is identical to JIO (Over Heaven)'s making him extremely good with the Miracle Timepiece. Traits like Nimble III, Godspeed, and curses with SPA reduction are best with this unit, as he has long SPA. (Costs 119.75K¥ to reach his maximum upgrade.)

Description
Per-Unit (single) DPS is usually what most people in the community talk about as calculations are easier without taking into account number of placement. Please keep in mind that while certain characters' singular DPS may be higher than others, placement limits affect Total DPS significantly. The approximate range for DPS (PER SINGLE UNIT) descriptions are:
Bad DPS 1,000-2000
Moderate DPS 2,001-3,000
Good DPS 3,001-4000
High DPS 4,001-5,000
Great DPS 5,001-6,000
Amazing DPS 6,001-7,000
Massive DPS 7,001-8,000
Insane DPS 8,001-9,000
Colossal DPS 9,001-10,000
Ultimate DPS 10,001-25,000
Godly DPS 25,001-30,000+
DPS accounts for the DMG (Damage) of a unit divided by its SPA (Attack Speed). The Total damage of a unit can be higher or lower as some units can only be placed 3, 4, 5, etc. amount times.

About
About
A catastrophic event has occurred that summoned countless threats in multiple worlds... but it also brought all the heroes together, and they need your help! 😱Can you summon the strongest heroes and save these worlds together?
Anime Adventures is a tower defense game made by Gomu. It was created on December 21, 2021 and officially released on July 3, 2022. Team up with others to beat ascending levels, or do it yourself and triumph above the strongest of enemies. Players gain Gems from beating Story and Infinite modes which can be used to summon more characters, or to buy items from the Travelling Merchant Shop. Level up your characters by beating Story and Infinite mode or using XP Food to make them stronger!

articles.title: Battlepass
articles.text:
- Collect XP by killing enemies in any game mode!
- Purchase a Premium Pass for Exclusive rewards!
★ All previous rewards are automatically claimed on purchase!
The Battlepass has 50 tiers, with the later half opening up after a week of release; a free and premium version. Each tier starts at 500 Battlepass points, going up to 1500 Battlepass points per tier which are obtained by killing enemies that can drop between 4 and 15 Battlepass points in any game mode.
You will need to collect 31250 Battlepass points in order to get to tier 50.
Each tier can offer the player Gems Gems, Gold, Reroll Tokens, Cursed Fingers, Star Capsules, Emotes, and exclusive units, with the premium version providing extra items and shiny units.
If you buy an outdated or previous gift of a premium pass, then it will stay the same and will not change or update.
Battlepass
Current Battlepass began in Update 18.0.0. Previous battlepasses can be found at Past Battlepasses.

Units sell for 25% of the sum of their deployment cost and upgrades.
Trivia
On Update 9.0.0, she used to heal 25 HP of tower HP per wave (stacks each unit), now she heals 3%-5% each wave (stacks each unit).
As of Update 12.5.0, she, Idol (Star) and Skeleton (Soul King) are the only ones capable of buffing both Physical and Magical damage.
She's the only character that can still be obtained as of now.
Before Update 4.0, she was a ground unit, meaning she could not be deployed on hill areas.
Before Update ???, her damage buff was 5% instead of 10%.

Calm Killer
Original Skin
"My name is Calm Killer. I'm 33 years old. My house is in the northeast section of Morioh, where all the villas are, and I am not married. I work as an employee for the Kame Yu department stores, and I get home every day by 8 PM at the latest. I don't smoke, but I occasionally drink. I'm in bed by 11 PM, and make sure I get eight hours of sleep, no matter what. After having a glass of warm milk and doing about twenty minutes of stretches before going to bed, I usually have no problems sleeping until morning. Just like a baby, I wake up without any fatigue or stress in the morning. I was told there were no issues at my last check-up. I'm trying to explain that I'm a person who wishes to live a very quiet life. I take care not to trouble myself with any enemies, like winning and losing, that would cause me to lose sleep at night. That is how I deal with society, and I know that is what brings me happiness. Although, if I were to fight I wouldn't lose to anyone."

articles.title: Challenges
articles.text:
Challenges are default Story Act with added difficulty, but also extra rewards. You must have the Story Act complete for the world to enter the Challenge.
Challenges change every 30 minutes
Information
These are the available Challenges
Tank Enemies - Enemies have more Health and Armor
High Cost - Units cost 1.5x higher to upgrade and place
Shield Enemies - Enemies have 1 additional instance of shields.
Regen Enemies - Enemies Regenerate health over time (except Flying enemies)
Short Range - All Units have a 2/3 shorter range
Fast Enemies - Enemies move faster
These are the Challenges that are only available at Demon Academy Portal
Hyper-Regen Enemies - Enemies Regenerate even more health over time (except Flying enemies)
Flying Enemies - All enemies are Flying (enemies that can regen still can regen)
Steel-Plated Enemies - Enemies have thrice the health, and have 20 additional instances of shields.
Godspeed Enemies - Enemies move even faster.
Mini Range - All Units have a 1/4 shorter range. Note that units' AoE aren't affected, making the likes of Hybrid Units or any unit with extreme AoE viable.
Triple Cost - Units cost 3x higher to upgrade and place.
Regular challenges
Daily Challenge
Regular challenges
Beating any of these Challenges can grant you the following rewards:

Chance at up to 7 of any of the star fruits.

200 Gold

s, and a chance for 1 Perfect Stat Cube
.

Note that he has a maximum of 3 summon (called Survey Corps Member) in the map per 1 Commander placed.
His buff stacks with Blossom which makes the Physical damage buff reach up to 35-110%.
Active Ability: Dedicate your hearts!
When activated, Commander increases the Physical damage stats of units in his range by 25%. If he buffs other Commanders in his range, their ability is going to buff by 56% to 95 to 100%. The buff lasts for 30 seconds and the ability has a cooldown of 60 seconds.
"Infinite" Buff Guide
Commander MUST BE CURSED with +SPA curse in order for this to work. ATTACK SPEED FROM STATS DO NOT MATTER AND DO NOT AFFECT ABILITY COOLDOWN.
The percent shouldn't really matter, but depending on how high or low the increase might effect how long the loop will last. (Not exactly sure on the specifics yet.)
Guide:
1. Place 4 Commander's, doesn't really matter the position as long as all they are all in each others range.
2. Activate the first Commander's ability, then wait 4-5 seconds. (Using an auto-clicker set to a 4-5 second interval can help if you are having trouble timing it.)
3. Activate a second Commander's ability. Then wait for the 25% buff to disappear.
4. As soon as the 25% disappears, immediately activate your third Commander's ability, then wait until the 56% buff to disappear.
5. As soon as the 56% disappears, immediately activate the your fourth Commander's ability.
After this they should all buff to 95% then loop 100% for a while, this loop isn't truly infinite since over time the ability will slowly desync, but if timed right can last for over 50 rounds, which is long enough for pretty much every situation.
Selling
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
Trivia
At the time Wind Dragon is added in the game, he was nerfed to the point he can only buff Physical damage units.
As of Update 14:
His ability is now available at Upgrade 0 instead of Upgrade 3.
He used to have maximum of 3 units per person. It's adjusted to 6 (global). This is the same thing inflicted to Wenda.
Chaining his buffs allows him to buff all Physical units by 100%, although to consistently do this you may need to apply curses to his SPA to get this to a full uptime, this also applies to Wenda.

articles.title: Contracts
articles.text:
A view of the contracts and buffs
Contracts are obtained from either the NPC Legendary Assassin (not to be confused with the unit Legendary Assassin), or also from the main menu. They make you kill a boss from a random map. Higher tier Contracts are more difficult, with the higher ones often having resistances. Typically, when you do a contract, it gives a very strong damage type buff and a less strong (but still good) secondary damage type buff.
Rewards
A view of the assassin banner
You can get two rewards from completing contracts, those being Assassin tokens and Death dice. Assassin tokens allow you to spin on the Assassin banner, from which you can get one of three units: Legendary Assassin, Somber, or Killstreak. Death Dice allow you to create a secret portal if you have four of them, from which you can get the unit Switchblade if you successfully complete the portal. The higher tier portals have a higher chance of giving a death dice. For the highest chance, you should attempt your highest tier contract every day in order to maximize rewards and take less time to get the secret unit, Switchblade.
Reset
Depending on the tier of a contract, it will reset after a certain amount of time, also known as a new contract. Typically, the lower tier contracts reset faster, in usually 5-10 minutes, while the higher tier ones take anywhere from 30 minutes to 2 hours. The highest one, at the very right of the contract menu, takes 12 hours to reset, otherwise it would be easy to get the secret.
Trivia
There are 16 tiers of contracts.
You can choose to either open a portal to attract people to do a contract or do matchmaking.
This makes contracts this first ever portal-reward system to utilize matchmaking.
For the highest chance of succeeding, be sure to bring units of the type that are buffed. If there are two secondary buff types (e.g. fire and storm) and one primary buff type (e.g. Physical) you should opt to get the unit with the Primary Buff type as opposed to the two secondary buff types (e.g. choose Guts as opposed to Sasuke).
Boss killer units and supports are heavily utilized in these stages, so make sure to bring them.
You gain 2500-5000 Cash per round (5000 when start) so you can place high cost units down quickly (e.g. Time Wizard in 2 Rounds)

articles.title: Currencies
articles.text:
Main Currencies
Event Currencies
There are currently three main currencies, that being Gems Gems, Gold and Trophies. They are used to purchase a variety of things in the game.
Gems
Gold
Trophies
Gems Gems
Gems Gems are one of the most important currencies in Anime Adventures, as they are used to obtain powerful Units. They can be obtained by completing Quests, Story Mode missions, Doing Raids, waves in Infinite Modes, redeeming Codes, staying in the Time Machine, logging in daily, events, Completing Infinity Castle rooms and buying them with Robux.
Gold
Gold is the 2nd most important currency, as they allow the Player to purchase powerful items such as XP Food, Star Fruits, Summon Tickets, and Raid Tickets. You can also use Gold to create Evolution Items and Relics. Gold can be earned through selling your Units, through events, and completing the Extra Gold Challenge.
In Update 10.7.5, you can now use gold to purchase more unit & skin slots at the Bartender NPC for increasing amounts of gold.
50,000 Gold for the first upgrade. (150 Slots)
75,000 Gold for the second upgrade. (200 Slots)
100,000 Gold for the last upgrade. (250 Slots)
Trophies
Trophies is the currency that allows the Player to purchase Emotes.
There are also various limited time currencies that can only be obtained during certain time frames or events. There is currently two of these, The Stars and the Assassin Tokens
Assassin Tokens
Template:Assassin Token is a currency introduced as part of update 19.5.0, The Sakamoto Days Update. It was used to purchase summons at the Limited Time Assassin Event Banner and used for evolving limited units from this update.
Stars
Stars Stars are commonly used for Christmas events, as they allow players to obtain skins or items that upgrade towers into different versions. Stars can be obtained by completing Quests, waves in Infinite Modes, and redeeming Codes and events.
Candies
Candies Candies are an event currency introduced as part of update 5.0. They are currently used to purchase XP food, capsules for character skins, Dungeon keys, and Evolution Items. Jewels can be earned by completing missions from the Mission Board and by selling Infused Crystals to the Mysterious Mage by the Dungeon entrance.
Pearls
Pearls was commonly used for the Summer event, as they allowed players to buy the Summer Portals and buy Evolution Items for the Summer Units
Grief Seeds
Grief Seeds is a currency introduced as part of update 13.5, The Madoka Magica Update. It was used to purchase summons at the Limited Time Madoka Magica Banner and used for buying Evolution Items.
Gun Devil Bullet
Gun Devil Bullets is a currency that allows you to make purchases in the Makimo's store, and also for it you can evolve some units.

Contract: Kon
Curse (Contract) gains 50% more damage from his Curse Devil Form but he gains 50% more SPA. He now has a bigger AOE from his previous form which lets him attack more enemies, but costing his ability to do multi-hit.
His Kon form is Recommended for crowd-control or killing a huge wave of enemies.
Contract: Curse Devil
Curse (Contract) applies a curse stack every time he lands a critical hit on an enemy. If he lands 4 Curse Stacks, he would deal an extra 200% more damage to enemies (true damage) . He is a multihit unit so he can attack multiple times in 1 attack (no dmg multipliers) significantly increasing his Curse Stack every attack. The Nail Relic can heavily boost his critical chance easily increasing his curse stack and activating his 200% true damage boost (true damage) but his AoE is smaller compared to his Contract: Kon, Form.
His Curse Devil form is recommended for slaying bosses, break down heavily shielded enemies or high HP enemy units.

articles.title: Damage Affinities / Elements
articles.text:
Damage Affinities are primary/secondary attacks of a specific units. They matter because in portals/legend stages each enemy has a resistance and weakness.
Icons and Symbols
In any Portal/Legend Stage there are enemies with resistances and weaknesses.
The damage affinity icon with a percent represents how much additional damage you would deal with that specific affinity
The picture above represents 150 Physical Resistance and 30% Magic Weakness, meaning they would take less damage when using a physical unit and they would take extra damage from magic units.
Weaknesses appear as an icon with a percentage above the enemy's health bar. Weakness increases damage received by X%, so an enemy with 30% Magic Weakness means units with the Magic trait will deal 30% more damage to them. For example: A Physical /Rose Unit that deals 10000 Damage against an enemy that has a 400% boost to Physical damage, and a 150% boost to Rose damage, will deal (10000)x(1.00+4.00+1.50) damage to the enemy, which equals 65000 damage.
Damage resistance appears as a shield above the enemy's health bar. Resistance reduces damage by 100 / (100 + Resistance), so an enemy with 150 Magic Resistance will only take 40% Magic Damage. Damage Penetration reduces Resistance.
Each Affinity Explained:
Magic Units that have supernatural abilities or magical spells.
Physical Units that use their hands or weapons with natural abilities.
True - Units with True Damage ignore type resistances on enemies, dealing the full damage to them without having it reduced by resistance. True damage also ignores damage resistance from enemies with the ice attribute.
Fire - Units with the element of Fire, most fire units have the ability to burn enemies, reducing their regen by a bit.
Aqua - Units with the element of Aqua.
Storm - Units with the element of Storm, most storm units have the ability to freeze/slow enemies.
Air - Units with the element of Air.
Rose - Units with the element of Rose.
Dark - Units with the element of Dark.
Light - Units with the element of Light.
Tips
Whenever you collect a portal, always check out the affinity icon showing their weakness. Try to use units with the affinity shown to complete the portal easier.
It is best to use Physical Units on Legend Stages with Magic Resistances, It is same for the Magical Units.
It is always best to use the recommended Affinities in challenges.
Always use relics to boost your units damage or penetration to resistances or PWR to increase DPS (It would be useful if your unit is weak because of resistances)
Buffs
Certain units have the ability to create damage buffs that significantly increases a unit's damage/DPS.
They would be very useful especially for portals, legend stages and challenges. Due to enemies with weaknesses or resistances.
Megomu (Chimera Shadow) can buff magic damage taken by an enemy by 30%
Blackhair can buff magic damage taken by an enemy by 15%
Commander's ability can buff physical units' damage by 25%(Stackable) for a limited time
Wenda's ability can buff magical units' damage by 30%(Stackable) for a limited time
Merlyn (Infinity)'s Hexed passive can buff magic damage taken by an enemy by 30% (permanent)
Sukuno and Switchblade's dismember passive can buff physical damage taken by an enemy by 25% (permanent)
Griffin (Ascension) passively buffs ALL units, including other players' units, by 100%. (permanent)
Oshy and her evolution passively buffs ALL units, but not including other players' units, depending on its upgrade (permanent).
Chuuni (Delusion) can buff magic damage taken by an enemy by 50%(Stackable) until she is no longer targetting the enemy.

Active Ability: Time Stop
Delinquent uses his stand ability to stop time, stunning enemies in place for 4 seconds. This ability makes Delinquent a nice unit to have in early game.
Though his attacks do not inflict Freeze (unlike JIO, Cold Mage and his evo, Snake Princess, etc.,), he is still recommended for everyone due to his strong range for his ability, extremely low CD of an active ability, especially you can activate it at the desired time. He benefits from SPA Curses extremely well due to even lowering the cooldown, but unlike Paradox (Divine Sight), his ability is hindered by Short Range challenges and the like. In addition to that, his overall cost is even cheaper than Time Wizard (Chrono)'s placement cost, costing 775¥ less.

articles.title: Divine General
articles.text:
Overview
Divine General is a MythicalMythical unit. Hе can only be obtained by upgrading Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual) to when he gets the Ritual skill, and using the Ritual active skill. The player will have the ability to control what mode Divine General fights in, these modes being: Attack, Defend, and Boss.
Stats Overview
Divine General
Deployment Cost
106,400¥
Total Cost
106,400¥
Upgrade Levels
0
Spawn Cap
1
Tower Type
Ground
Damage Type
Magic
Secondary Damage Type
Dark
Attacks
Scream
Car Toss
Slash
Jump
In Defend Mode, Divine General uses a Full AOE attack to scream at his current location. This attack deals about 0.51x the value of the Damage stat or equally 1.66x the value of the Summon stat of the Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual) used to summon Divine General. This attack triggers at a rate of about 1x the SPA of Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual). His Jump attack triggers at a rate of about 2x the SPA of Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual). This attack targets the First enemy on the map.
In Attack Mode, Divine General uses a Circle AOE attack to throw a car at enemies. This attack deals 1.25x the amount of damage of his Scream attack. This attack triggers at a rate of about 1x the SPA of Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual). His Jump attack triggers at a rate of about 2x the SPA of Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual). This attack targets the First enemy on the map.
In Boss Mode, Divine General uses a Single Target attack to teleport to an enemy and slash them. This attack deals 2.5x the amount of damage of his Scream attack. This attack triggers at a rate of about 0.5x the SPA of Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual). His Jump attack triggers at a rate of about 1.5x the SPA of Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual). This attack targets the Strongest enemy on the map.
Used in all Modes, Divine General uses a Circle AOE attack to disappear from the map and land on a targeted enemy (targeting varies based on mode). This attack deals 2x the amount of damage of his Scream attack. This attack's rate seems to vary depending on the mode.
Adaption
Divine General has the ability to adapt every time he kills an enemy or assists in killing an enemy. The player will be able to choose an adaptation (one of three) every 50 takedowns. Divine General becomes fully adapted once all adaptations have been unlocked (150 total takedowns).
Divine Wings
Heavenly Force
Adapted Slash
Divine Wings turns Divine General hybrid. Allowing Divine General to target and attack flying enemies.
Heavenly Force adds the Knockback effect to his Scream and Jump attacks.
Adapted Slash grants a +100% Crit Rate while using his Slash attack.
Trivia
Divine General is currently bugged, whenever it is summoned it will always be its shiny version.
Divine General is the first summon unit that can walk while attacking and does not die when colliding with another unit.
Although Divine General's Scream attack damage depends on the Summon value of the Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual) used to summon Divine General, all of his other attacks' damage seemingly scales off of his Scream attack instead, if you have buffs applied to the Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual) they do not carry over to Divine General, instead Divine General only takes the buffless dmg
Divine General is able to be buffed by limit breaks, applying a 30% damage boost to all his attacks. When applied with the damage boost Shadow Sorcerer (Ritual) gains, he can gain a x1.69 damage boost from max limit break.
Divine General can be buffed by Elfy (Sylph), Wind Dragon, Griffin (Reincarnation), Zombie (Risen), and Blossom if Divine General is within their range.
Divine General wont be buffed by Zombie (Risen) if Divine General is summoned before Zombie (Risen) is placed

articles.title: Dungeon
articles.text:
Dungeons is a game mode that adds a choose your own adventure feeling to the game.
in order to start a dungeon, the player must have a dungeon key which can be obtained through Daily Quests, the gambler npc outside of Summon.
upon starting a dungeon, the key will be consumed, and the player will be granted 3 choices, the three Tiles on the bottom show you what loot you will get for winning that Match, the Tiles on top of the bottom Tiles show what games you will be able to choose next, choosing a different bottom Tile changes what your next Match options will be.
through playing the dungeon games the player is able to receive rewards like hoard, chests, and rare chests.
when choosing which game to play there will be smaller Tiles in the option Tile telling you what your rewards will be, theses Smaller tiles can be any of:
Hoard
Shop
Curse
Chest
Rare Chest
Open
Relics
The Hoard Tile, upon completion, will give you Currency called Dungeon Money, which can be used in the Shop Tile
the shop Tile, upon completion of that game, will open a shop ui which allows you to spend your Hoard in return for blessings
The Curse Tile will add a curse to your Dungeon inventory. More information about the curse can be viewed by hovering over the tile.
the Chest Tile, upon completion of that game, will give the player a chest
the Rare Tile square, upon completion of that game, will give the player a rare chest
Upon completion, you will have the ability to open Treasure Chests or Rare Chests. It is recommended to NOT open Rare Chests before the end, since you'll have a chance to get a Secret Unit.
Treasure Chests can give Stat Rerolls, 150 Gems150 Gems, and 2 Star Remanents.
Rare Chests can give Stat Rerolls, 450 Gems450 Gems, 5 Star Remanents, Curse Tokens, and the chance for a Secret Unit
the Relic square, upon completion of that game, will open a Relic UI, where you can choose to take a relic or not, relics can give both curses and blessings, and the relic will tell you what the curses and blessings are

articles.title: Effects
articles.text:
Effects are the variety of mechanics some Units are capable of doing in certain situations. Effects range from unit buffs, enemy debuffs, or economy.
Support
Income: Generate money after each wave.
Weather Girl (Thief) is different and can generate cash from her 'Treasure Thief' ability causing enemies to spawn with a glowing gold symbol on them which gives the player money on kill.
Healer: Heals the base by restoring lost base Hp, or even giving extra HP to the base after each wave.
Buff: Buff certain aspects of the unit such as Range, Damage, or SPA. Discounts given to upgrades from a unit also falls under this.
Commander can only buff Physical units while Wind Dragon can only buff Magic units. Griffin (Reincarnation) can buff both Physical and Magic Damage. Oshy (Idol) is the only unit that can give discounts to upgrades for units.
Debuff: Debuff enemies by making them take more damage from a specific attack type.
Cursed King and Switchblade can make enemies permanently take 20% more Physical damage. Although Blackhair can make enemies take 15% more Magic damage and Shadow Sorcerer (Hybrid Shadow) can make enemies temporarily take 30% more Magic damage. Infinity Mage (Endless) can make enemies permanently take 30% more magic.

How Each Effect Works
Enemy Effects
Burn: Deals DoT (Damage over time) for every hit. (Burn instances stack with other burn instances inflicted by other towers). The bleed deals damage based on a percentage the unit's base damage.
Bleed: Deals DoT (Damage over time) after hit and it entirely stops the HP Regen of an enemy unit who has the ability to RGN (regen). (Bleed instances stack with other burn instances inflicted by other towers). The bleed deals damage based on a percentage the unit's base damage.
Bleed Amplify: Units with this passive are able to Amplify the amount of Bleed Damage a bleed unit is capable of doing, the increase can range from 3x to 5x (varies based on upgrades). This passive is permanent (it lasts until the enemy dies).
Wither: Ashborn (Decay) applies the Wither debuff when he attacks which applies a maximum 18 ticks of true damage and disables HP regen of enemies while the effect is active.
Slow: Manipulates the speed of the enemies when hit by a unit with this effect, resulting in a massive decrease in the speed at which the enemy moves. (Has a cooldown of 7 seconds)
Stun: Completely restricts movement of enemies for the duration of the effect. (Has a cooldown of 10-14 seconds)
Cursed: Makes enemies take additional damage from magic damage. This buff can range from 15% (Blackhair to 30% Shadow Sorcerer (Hybrid Shadow)).
Confused: Makes all enemies in range walk backwards for 5 seconds.
Knockback: Pushes enemy towards back the way it was coming from. (Has a cooldown of 30-31 seconds)
Freeze: Completely restricts movement of enemies for the duration of the effect. The duration at which the freeze lasts is dependent on the unit which casts it. (Has a cooldown of 12-13 seconds)
Shatter: Removes all shield instances on enemies when hit.
Unconscious: Enemy is knocked out and stopped in place for 3-4 seconds.
Dismembered: Causes the enemy to seemingly lose a body part and take increased physical damage permanently.
Chrono Reversal: Similar to Confused, makes all enemies in range walk backwards for 5 seconds. This ability also does 100% of the units damage in 5 ticks(20% per tick) to all enemies in their radius. Note that its a manual ability and it cannot work on bosses.
Snatched: Each attack increases damage by 3% up to 33% (99% on a max upgrade) for 90 seconds.
Mind Control: Forces enemies with a 10% chance in range to walk back for 1.5 seconds.
Hexed: Similar to Dismembered, Curses the enemy and increases their magic damage taken resulting in taking a permanent 30% more magic damage.
Poison: Deals DoT (Damage over time) for every hit.
Unit Effects
Crit: A percent chance to deal/land a critical hit. When landing a critical hit the unit would deal 1.5x (+50% DMG) more damage and x2 Crit DMG (+100%) for Lex Akoman.
Over Crit: Sepsis (Moon) is able to do guarantees a critical hit on enemies that currently bleeding making his DPS increase by 50% consistently when paired with Saka (Ribbon).
Motivate: Each attack buffs all allies in range by 15% damage or 10% range for 10 seconds. This can stack independently with different durations, but same effects do not stack. However, this can stack with other buffs like Wind Dragon's, Skeleton (Soul King), Commander's, Blossom's, Trickster (Release)'s or Elfy (Sylph)'s.
Battlelust: Each attack that hits and enemy gives 5% more damage buff for Karma (Thunder Fiend) with a max stack of 25%. The effect will reset if the unit doesn't hit anything for too long.
Curse Stack: Each attack that unit lands a critical hit that unit adds a curse stack effect after 4 curse stacks (dealing a critical attack x4) it can deal 200% more damage as True
True Damage: True Damage units can ignore resistances/shields from enemies when attacking.
Wild Card: Each of Mangaka (Artist)'s attacks will have one of these effects: Freeze/Slow/Knockback/Bleed/Burn at random.
Trivia
Before Update 8, stuns, freezes, and walkbacks didn't have a delay on different effects on each other.
Notes
Please, keep in mind that this page is still in development, we don't know which unit has an effect and which doesn't, to make this page even better than it is currently we will need help from everyone who has any info, or that knows how to edit it right.
If you're having difficulty looking at unit icons or switching between effect tabs, try switching to a different window tab for several seconds before returning to this tab.

Summons: Abyssal Jellies
Elyssia has the ability to summon Abyssal Jellies.
Abyssal Jelly
Abyssal Jellies will be summoned on Elyssia's SPA maxing out at 3. Abyssal Jellies have only 1 HP, but explode dealing a full AoE burst of Magic damage equal to Elyssia's damage on death. The range of this explosion is believed to be equivalent to Elyssia's range. Once an Abyssal Jelly dies, she will be put on cooldown for 1.5x her SPA and begin summoning another one afterwards.
Selling
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
Trivia
Summons possess the same types Elyssia has.
Abyssal Jellies can break 2 shields due to the explosion they deal on contact.
Her summons can be buffed by Zombie (Risen).
Elyssia will be put on cooldown if an Abyssal Jelly dies before she has summoned all three, causing her to only summon one.
Since Elyssia gets put on cooldown anytime an Abyssal Jelly dies, some strange situations can occur if she is on cooldown and another Abyssal Jelly dies:
Her cooldown will be reset, causing her to only start summoning the dead Abyssal Jellies after 1.5x her SPA at the time the second Abyssal Jelly died rather than the first.
Her summoning can be canceled if an Abyssal Jelly dies as the animation is playing, causing no Abyssal Jelly to spawn once her animation ends.

Passive Ability: Elyssia's Seaborn
Elyssia (Abyssal) has the ability to summon Abyssal Jellies and Abyssal Eels.
Echoes From Below
Wretched Communion
Abyssal Jellies will be summoned on Elyssia (Abyssal)'s SPA maxing out at 3. Abyssal Jellies have only 1 HP, but explode dealing a full AoE burst of Magic damage equal to Elyssia (Abyssal)'s damage on death. The range of this explosion is believed to be equivalent to Elyssia (Abyssal)'s range. Once an Abyssal Jelly dies, she will be put on cooldown for 1.5x her SPA and begin summoning another one afterwards.
Abyssal Eels will be summoned once Elyssia (Abyssal) takes down 5 enemies. Abyssal Eels will be spawned near Elyssia (Abyssal) maxing out at 3, despawning after a minute passes. Abyssal Eels will attack with a small circle AoE with 1/4x Elyssia (Abyssal)'s damage, 2x her SPA, and 2.5x her range.
Selling
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
Trivia
Summons possess the same damage type, element type and relic Elyssia (Abyssal) has.
Abyssal Jellies can break 2 shields due to the explosion they deal on contact.
Both of her summons can be buffed by Zombie (Risen).
Since Abyssal Jellies are summons that move down the path, they are able to hit flying enemies, while Abyssal Eels only count as ground and cannot.
Elyssia (Abyssal) will be put on cooldown if an Abyssal Jelly dies before she has summoned all three, causing her to only summon one.
Since Elyssia (Abyssal) gets put on cooldown anytime an Abyssal Jelly dies, some strange situations can occur if she is on cooldown and another Abyssal Jelly dies:
Her cooldown will be reset, causing her to only start summoning the dead Abyssal Jellies after 1.5x her SPA at the time the second Abyssal Jelly died rather than the first.
Her summoning can be canceled if an Abyssal Jelly dies as the animation is playing, causing no Abyssal Jelly to spawn once her animation ends.

articles.title: Enemy Mechanics
articles.text:
Some enemies have abilities with a cost on them which may disable effects from certain units.
Enemy Type
Effects
Counters
First Encounter
Shielded Enemies
Will appear with a set amount of shield, the shield will be depleted by one point every hit.
Hard Counter: Multi-hit units, and Shatter units will shred shields.
Soft Counter: Inhuman also shred these via his ability. The thing is, they return back after some time!
Challenge: Shield Enemies
Shiganshinu District, Act 4 (Wave 15)
Tank enemies
Appearing with a white glow over their model, they take slightly reduced damage overall.
Any non-damaging effect still works at full effect. However, Inhuman's ability temporarily nullifies the effect!
First Debut: Challenge: Tank Enemies
Story Debut: Marine's Ford (Marine Flagbearer)
Fire enemies
Will move faster than normal enemies and cause ice units to deal less damage. They also happen to be immune of slows and stuns.
Other units that can do effects other than slows and stuns (especially Freeze).
Dazai may remove that trait, for them to be able to get stunned or slowed for awhile.
Magic Town, Act 2 (Wave 10)
Ice enemies
Will take less damage from normal units.
Fire-aligned units deal THRICE the damage on these types of enemies.
Anyone witb a burn will also suffice, as the effect in question has Fire attribute (even if their attribute isn't even Fire , meaning units like Shinobi (Eternal) will also counter those enemies very well!
Inhuman may remove that trait for non-Fire aligned units to deal usual damage, but will remove the intended counter for awhile.
Magic Town, Act 4 (Wave 10)
Regen Enemies
Will regenerate health when damaged.
Ashborn, Inhuman's ability, or units that deal bleeding damage will temporarily nullify its effects.
Snowy Town, Act 4 (Wave 10)
Flying Enemies
Ignores ground units and can only be hit by hill units and hybrid unit.
High DPS hill units or Hybrid ground units. Or Inhuman's ability can nullify their trait for Ground units to be able to hit them.
Hollow World, Act 1 (Wave 10)
Armored Enemies
Full AoE units deal half the damage against these units.
All other units deal damage regularly against them. And Full AoE effect characters still affect them at full duration (e.g. Shadowgirl (Time Traveller) or Frost Navy (Blue Pigeon)).
The same intended nerf can be nullified for awhile by Inhuman's ability.
First Debut: Witch City Portals
Story Debut: Virtual Dungeon, Act 4 (Wave 10)
Burst Enemies
They spawn really fast, but slow down as they get closer to your base.
Don't place your units close to the spawn area.
The same intended nerf can be nullified for awhile by Inhuman's ability.
First Debut: Frozen Abyss (Holiday Event 2024)

Enlightened (Nirvana) is able to cycle between three different modes: Normal Mode, Bleed Mode and Hybrid Mode.
Normal Mode
Bleed Mode
Hybrid Mode
Enlightened (Nirvana) attacks with a Staff with a small circle AoE. While in this mode, Enlightened (Nirvana) has a single hit attack with low SPA.
Enlightened (Nirvana) attacks with a Scythe with a large circle AoE. While in this mode, Enlightened (Nirvana) has a single hit attack with 1.5 times longer SPA than Normal Mode. Enlightened (Nirvana) will inflict bleed equal to 30% of his damage over 3 ticks.
In Bleed Mode, he has 13.33% less average DPS than normal mode. However with bleed amplification (x5 bleed dmg), he has 66.66% more average DPS.
Enlightened (Nirvana) attacks with a Halberd with a line AoE. While in this mode, Enlightened (Nirvana) has a single hit attack with 1.5 times more damage, 2 times longer SPA, and 1.5 times more range than Normal Mode. Enlightened (Nirvana) becomes hybrid, gaining the ability to attack flying enemies.

Stars are an event currency introduced as part of the christmas update. They are currently used to purchase the Frozen Star, and evolution items for the mythic units in the Frozen Star.
Holiday Rewards
Holiday Rewards are a daily stamp that you can claim once you log into the game, the rewards ranging from 250/500 Gems250/500 Gems, Trait Rerolls, and 1000 Stars1000 Stars.
Frozen Portals
The Frozen Portals are portals used to go into frozen variants of story mode maps (excluding Marine's Ford), each portals is assigned with a tier, ranging from tiers 1-12, each tier getting harder with more rewards and assigned with challenges, portals tier 3 and above have a chance to drop the Secret Portal, when completed, gives the owner of the portal Ice Queen.

Halloween 2022
Candies are an event currency introduced as part of update 5.0. They are currently used to purchase XP food, capsules for character skins, Dungeon keys, and Evolution Items.
Spooky Fortune
Candies can be used to buy lottery tickets once every 24 hours for 150 Candies150 Candies to enter the draw for a shot a prize of large amounts of candy.

articles.title: Experiment X (Imperfect)
articles.text:
If you were looking for a different Experiment X unit, see Experiment X (disambiguation).
Overview
Experiment X (Imperfect) is a Epic unit. He is obtainable through the West city raid with a unknown chance, or by Raid Shop.
Evolving

articles.title: Explode Star
articles.text:
The Explode Star, added in Update 16, is a reward obtained from reaching Room 100 in the Infinity Castle (9th Season).
As of 30/09/23, the day of Update 17, and the end of Season 9, the Explode Star could be opened to receive Bombietta.
Information
+Required to obtain a special unit...
"If you throw away your life in battle, where's the point in winning?!!"
This Star is sealed with a powerful magic and cannot be opened yet...
Rewards
Bombietta

Active Ability: Zanka No Tachi
Yamamoto gains one soul for each kill (including kills prior to upgrade 8). When you activate his ability, he starts a hybrid attack that hits several times and multiplies his base damage depending on the amount of souls received. The attack deals Yamamoto's base damage, plus 2% damage for every soul consumed in the attack. If he consumes 50 souls, he would be doing 200% damage (100% damage + (50 x 2%) = 200%). At 500 souls, he does 1100% damage or 1,063,069.48 damage with his manual ability.
Selling
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
Trivia
It is recommended to use his ability if you are struggling to finish off strong flying enemies in his range, or to save the souls for when a strong boss without shields appears.
Zanka no Tachi caps out at 500 souls (+1000% damage), and any kills past the 500 mark will not be counted for his next ability usage.
He was obtainable as a 5% secret drop in Karakora Town The Fire dungeon. This was changed on 1/14/23.
His shiny skin is based on the younger Yamamoto's appearance in the original series.

articles.text:
The Flash Star, added in Update 14, is a reward obtained from reaching Room 100 in the Infinity Castle (8th Season).
As of 19/08/23, the day of Update 16, and the end of Season 8, the Flash Star could be opened to receive Minata.

This Star is sealed with a powerful magic and cannot be opened yet...

articles.title: Frequently Asked Questions
articles.text:
Q: Is the game available on Mobile?
Yes
Q: Is the game available on Xbox?
Not yet.
Q: What is the difference in damage between a Level 1 Unit and a Level 100 Unit?
A Level 100 Unit does around 9.204x more damage than a Level 1 Unit.
Q: What does Critical Chance do?
Some MythicalMythical and Secret units with critical chance can deal a critical attack, which makes it do 50% more damage. The exception is Levy Ackman, who does 100% more damage when he attacks with his critical hit. Refer to the Critical section on the Effects page.
Q: How do I get more Gems?
Refer to the Gems section on the Currencies page.
Q: Why do I get items from the banner? Does this mean I didn't get a unit?
No, items are rare drops from the banner in addition to specific units. You always get at least one unit for each summon.
Q: The game is too laggy, what can I do to reduce lag?
You can reduce the lag by turning off some options in Settings.
Q: What codes are there?
Refer to the Codes page.
Q: What are Shiny Units?
Shiny units are very rare skins for units and are purely cosmetic. You have a small chance to get a shiny from each summon. Also, you can remove shiny on units with rarity Legendary or Mythical for star remnants.
Q: What are traits?
Traits are special unit powerups that can significantly boost its Damage, SPA & Range. For more details, refer to the to the Traits page.
Q: Why are my unit stats different than my friend's if they are the same character?
Units have randomized stats that boost its Damage, SPA & Range. For more details, refer to the Powerups page.
Q: How do I play Infinite Mode?
Finish all Levels of a World to unlock its Infinite Mode. Each world's Infinite Mode has its leaderboard, and you can gain gems by reaching certain waves per day for each world's Infinite Mode.
Q: Do gems save when you get kicked/disconnected from the Time Machine?
Refer to the Time Machine page.
Q: What do some abbreviations mean on some pages?
Refer to the Terminology page.
Q: What is the difference between Kills and Takedowns?
Kills are only registered if the unit itself kills the enemy. For example, if Uru and Aizen are on the map, if Uru does the "final hit" it only registered for Uru. Takedowns are some-what like "mob-sharing", meaning as long as the unit hits the enemy, whether it does the final hit or not, a takedown is registered.
Q: How does one level up their units quickly?
To quickly level up a unit to level 50 - 60, you can just play with a unit in a latest story mode. To quickly level up a unit to level 100, fuse the unit with legendary units summoned from banner or feed them with EXP items which can be obtain from playing any story mode (Prefer Magic Town map above) or buy from Hurbis store.
Q: How to use limit break?
To limit break, a unit must be in rarity either Mythic or Secret and they must be at least level 100 (max). Go to the limit break section, and sacrifice at least 12 mythic units (6 if evolved) and a wish star in order to limit break its level, extend 10 more levels. For more information, refer to Powerups page.
Q: How to get Supreme Being?
To get Supreme Being, you need to summon a unit from Dungeon Throne units from the banner to get the Staff, the units are: Bloodcry, Thunder maid, Lucifer, Cherub. Sacrifice 3 of those unit after they evolved to obtain him (Can sacrifice 2 of same evolved units).
Q: How do farm takedown fast?
To farm takedown on a unit, you need to use them on killing enemies in Wall City infinite mode, which is the most efficiency way to farm takedown due to its 2nd easiest world and the Massive Colossus enemy can spawn more enemies to get more takedown.
Q: What does takedown do?
Takedown are usually required for most world/raid units to evolve. It also required for getting worthiness in order to improve the units stats from Cosmic Cat when rerolling a unit stats.

Luck Bar
Gambler (Jackpot) is able to gain luck with every attack. From Upgrades 0-5, he will gain +5% luck per hit (with 1 hit). From Upgrades 6-8, he will gain +3.3% luck per hit (with 3 hits). Luck gained per hit has a chance to be tripled, scaling off his Crit Rate (50% chance to triple with 50% Crit Rate, 100% chance to triple with 100% Crit Rate). Upon reaching 100% luck, Gambler (Jackpot)'s ability will activate Frenzy.
Frenzy
Once activating Gambler (Jackpot)'s ability with 100% luck, he will activate a frenzy for all units within his range (including himself). Frenzy will increase Crit Rate for Units in range by +50% (this does not work on True damage type units such as Umbra (Nuclear)) for 30 seconds with about a 32 seconds cooldown (No Global Cooldown).
Selling
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
Trivia
This is the first support unit to buff crit chance
This is currently the only known way for magic damage units to critically hit.
Although it is possible to maintain perfect uptime with Gambler at upgrade 0 and 3, it is very unreliable. Upgrade 6 is necessary for consistent uptime with Frenzy.

articles.text:
Overview
Griffin is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable from summon. When you obtain Griffin you will automatically be rewarded the Periapt of the King.
Evolving
Griffin can evolve into Griffin (Ascension) with the following materials:
Required Items:
x1 Griffin
Result
Griffin
(Ascension)
Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 7,500 Takedowns.
[1]
Additionally, he requires at least 100% Ascension in the Periapt of the King to evolve.
About Ascension
When one uses the Periapt of the King in the Items section of their inventory, they will be teleported to a domain. By talking to the Griffin (Fallen) NPC, the player will be immediately given the choice between [Ascend] and [Sacrifice]. If [Sacrifice] is selected, the player will be offered a choice between sacrificing Periapts of Sacrifice, which raises Ascension by 0.5% each, or sacrificing Mythic units, giving 4.2% for unevolved units and 8.4% for evolved units. Any Mythics can be sacrificed, including Griffin and his evolved variant. If [Ascend] is selected the inventory will pop up, prompting the player to pick the Griffin they want to evolve, consuming 100% of the Ascension stored.
Do note that before sacrificing an eligible unit, one will be given a warning similar to that seen when sacrificing eligible units to the Sovereign's Staff.

Selling
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
Disclaimer
Upgrading Griffin (Darkness) can get very, very expensive depending on how many towers you sacrifice. It is heavily not recommended to sell him, as you will not be refunded yen from towers that you have sacrificed. Place. Him. Carefully.
Sacrifice Condition
Griffin (Darkness) is awakened from Griffin (Ascension) using non-buffing units using his ability. His ability deletes all units within his range and depending on the value of the units the percent he gains is higher. You gain 1% for each 1000¥ spent on sacrificed units.
Griffin's damage multiplier can be exactly calculated with the equation: dmg multi =(cost^0.47)/6.0714. A high percentage you can get is 2551% you can get this by using Berserker (Rage), Illusionist (Final), Stringy (Awakened), Golden Tyrant (Emperor), and Usurper (Founder). With 2551% your Griffin (Darkness) can do 302,110 DPS (varies depending on stats and potential). With 2551%, Wenda, Griffin Reincarnation, and Pucci Heaven your Griffin Darkness will do 1,510,550 DPS. however this is not his max because Paradox (Divine Sight) can be given an infinite amount of upgrades because of limitless, just him to Limitless 10 will give a total of 900k cost.
Trivia
Idol (Star)'s cost reduction DOES affect how many percents you will get from sacrificing units. For example, sacrificing a fully-upgraded Millie (Holy) will give 96% to Griffin (Ascension) without Idol (Star)'s buff, while doing the same with 20% cost reduction (fully-upgraded Idol (Star)) will only give 77%.
The current percentage cap for this unit is unknown. The more expensive the unit sacrificed, the more damage Griffin (Darkness) will gain. Therefore, theoretically, the unit's damage is infinite, as long as you have the money, time, and the appropriate unit(s) to sacrifice. Who knows when we will need a new Money Unit to utilize this monster?
How to get the most damage out of Griffin (Darkness)?
Get Griffin (Ascension)'s sacrifice meter to 95%+; you can, boost the meter up to 99% or even 100% (rounded of 99.5%-99.9%) but remember to calculate carefully since the unit will transform once it hits 100% and you will lose the opportunity to boost Griffin's damage further. (This unit is sellable but you will NOT be refunded) (Note: 1k¥ spent on unit(s) = 1% sacrifice meter.)
Place and fully-upgrade ALL of your main damage dealing units within Griffin (Ascension)'s range.
Hit the Sacrifice ability.
In case you have brought Idol (Star) into the game and you still want to get Griffin (Darkness)'s damage as high as possible, you can copy the steps mentioned above; however, instead of placing Idol (Star) at the beginning of the game, you may want to place her when you have finished all the sacrificing. By doing this, not only will you still get the maximum damage possible (without the 20% money discount), you will also get the 15% damage bonus from Idol (Star)'s passive ability!

Good DPS 3,001-4000

Amazing DPS 6,001-7,000

DPS accounts for the DMG (Damage) of a unit divided by its SPA (Attack Speed). The Total damage of a unit can be higher or lower as some units can only be placed 3, 4, 5, etc. amount times.

Ultimate DPS, Low SPA, Great Range. Upon reaching Upgrade 8, Vegita becomes apart of the affinity of Hybrid Units. Vegita's damage capabilities are truly insane which are allowed by his high damage, fairly low SPA, range and his placement cap of 3! Upon release, this unit was being compared to Geno (Incinerate) because of there extremely similar stat bases, but Vegita comes out on top, being an INSANE hybrid unit and EXTREMELY great physical unit. Vegita barely beats Metal Knight because of their DPS's being so close, however, with a placement cap of 3, allowing him to do more DPS and DPM. Vegita is often slept on for his damage, but he can truly be one heck of a DPS unit in both infinite mode, story, and legend stages! Per-Unit (single) DPS is usually what most people in the community talk about as calculations are easier without taking into account number of placement. Please keep in mind that while certain characters' singular DPS may be higher than others, placement limits affect Total DPS significantly. The approximate range for DPS (PER SINGLE UNIT) descriptions are:
Bad DPS 1,000-2000
Moderate DPS 2,001-3,000
Good DPS 3,001-4000
High DPS 4,001-5,000
Great DPS 5,001-6,000
Amazing DPS 6,001-7,000
Massive DPS 7,001-8,000
Insane DPS 8,001-9,000
Colossal DPS 9,001-10,000
Ultimate DPS 10,001-25,000
Godly DPS 25,001-30,000+
DPS accounts for the DMG (Damage) of a unit divided by its SPA (Attack Speed). The Total damage of a unit can be higher or lower as some units can only be placed 3, 4, 5, etc. amount times.

articles.text:

Illusionist (Fusion) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable through evolving Illusionist (Chrysalis).
Evolving
Illusionist (Fusion) can be evolved from Illusionist (Chrysalis) with the following materials:
Required Items:
x1 Illusionist (Chrysalis)

Illusionist (Fusion)
You also need to at least kill 5000 enemies during Illusionist (Chrysalis) form and 62.5% awakening.
To get Worthy Souls (each Worthy Soul has 0.5% awakening), you need to either clear Spirit Town - Act 6 (Legend Stage), or by sacrificing MythicalMythical units for 12.5% each.

articles.title: Infinite
articles.text:
"Infinite Mode" is a mode where the Player defends against endless waves of enemies, with each wave progressively getting harder. "Infinite Mode" is only available on "Hard Mode". There is a leaderboard for top "Infinite Mode" players in the "Leaderboard" area. Players who are able to maintain their leaderboard position until the end of the month will receive an exclusive unit.
The amount of gems you get per wave varies:
Wave 1-5: none
Wave 6 : 18 Gems18 Gems
Wave 7-15 : 3 Gems3 Gems
Wave 15-100: 5 Gems5 Gems
Do note that from wave 105 onwards gems are no longer rewarded for completing them, maxing at 497 Gems497 Gems . (confirmed until wave 146)
Daily rewards :
Wave 10: 90 Gems90 Gems
Wave 25: 180 Gems180 Gems
Wave 50: 330 Gems330 Gems
Other Rewards
Wave 10+ (On Loss): XP Items and XP for units.
Some Infinite Modes, such as Snowy Kingdom, may also reward players with other items, such as Portals or Dungeon Keys upon completing.
Bosses
Bosses from the previous acts of the story mode spawn every 10 waves
Trivia
Leaving in the middle of the infinite will reward you gems, but you will lose out on XP and XP Items.
The Daily Rewards used to be 10 Gems10 Gems, 25 Gems25 Gems and 50 Gems50 Gems respectively, but it was buffed at Update X.
Walled City is the best infinite to get takedowns for worthiness, as the Massive Colossus enemy spawns in more enemies upon death, along with the enemies having little health compared to most other infinites.

articles.text:
Information
This page classifies different units to different ranks depending on how good they are in Infinity Castle
Units are ranked based on the following statistics:
DPS(Damage Per Second)
TDPS(Total Damage Per Second)
SPA(Second Per Attack)
AoE(Area of Effect)
(as well as many other properties of a unit; Cost, Abilities, Effects, etc)
The ranking of each unit is based on how well they preform on each map in infinity castle
This tier list ranks units based on their base stats, and their potential including buffs, supports, and relics.
This tier list IS BASED ON TRAITLESS UNITS, NOT UNIQUE. Most of the units in the top of each tier happen to be the best for castle with unique as well.

articles.title: Infinity Mansion
articles.text:
Muzo
"I am an eternal creature infinitely close to perfection."
The Infinity Mansion, introduced in Update 6 as Infinity Castle, is a mode where the player is challenged with a series of seemingly infinite rooms. It's EXTREMELY tedious, but the rewards are worth your while!
Information
As of Update 18, for the first 63 rooms in the Mansion, the player is tasked with beating 3 acts of each story all the way up until Rain village gaining 150 gems for each floor.
After the 57th room, the Mansion becomes unpredictable, however the next three floors after the 57th room will have higher HP before nerfing down at the 60th room onwards, so be careful!
Starting Season 2, on Floors 100 and higher, resistances show up, the further you go the stronger those values are.
To access the Mansion, talk to the Muzo NPC by spawn. After heading inside, the Nakimo NPC will let you challenge the Mansion!
From this season 9, you can change the mode to hard, it will clear 2 rooms, but the stage will be harder! However, after the 100th room, the mode is always set to hard, but you do not clear 2 rooms at once getting 300 gems instead of 150.
At the end of every season, players are awarded based on their performance in the Infinity Mansion. The ranks go as the following:

Passive Ability: Arsenal Drones
Iron Knight (Arsenal) can spawn Arsenal Drones every time he takes down 20 enemies (despite showing it is 50). Note that its drones' attacks are not AoE and has 3 hits.

Passive Ability: Black Flames
Enemies can take more Burn DoT and he can deal 100% burn damage making his burn DPS very efficient. it's also really good for Fire Affinity Stages (weakness), or any stages with Ice enemies involved, such as Magic Town or Clover Kingdom.
However, it's worth noting that since half of his damage comes from burn, he isn't as effective against Regen enemies. This is because burn damage is dealt over time; as a result, it gives Regen enemies time to heal. Consider a Regen enemy with 2000 HP, an Itochi (Susanoo) that does 1000 damage plus 1000 burn, and a different character that does 2000 damage. Since Itochi (Susanoo)'s burn occurs over time, the enemy would be able to regen and survive his attack. On the other hand, the character that dealt the damage all at once would prevent regeneration from occurring.
With the Infernal Gaze, his Burn Damage will be doubled and given his duration of 10 ticks (100% before the relic is applied), he would technically deal triple damage if including his normal damage. A max level Izo (Samurai) can deal up to 660k+ damage with his burn, each burn dealing around 30k damage and also adding on the initial attack damage. His burn stacks with other burn units.

JIO (Over Heaven) is the first secret unit which could be pulled from an event star, which is also now over. Since the 2023 summer update, he is now not the only unit to be obtained like this, units like Pirate King (Final), Dracula (Unholy King), and Illusionist (Transcended) are obtained the same way.
This was the hardest unit to get, not only for the winter update, but overall, due to its unreleased drop chance (predicted to be 1/200k or (0.000005%)).
The shiny version of him is so rare that trading for it is almost impossible due to this shiny unit's value being labelled as "Owner's Choice", meaning so few exists that the owner gets to decide the value of the unit. This unit with unique gets very overpowered with a dps increase of 433% due to its one placement, that is also valid for ainz and other units with one placement
This unit is one of the most valuable units in the entire game, as its value can reach up to 80,000 Robux due to its rarity and ludicrous amount of damage with the "Unique" trait equipped.
Since the Update 19.0, he got a 50% buff.

articles.title: Legend Stages
articles.text:
Legend Stages are stages that are separate from story. Furthermore, you need to previously have unlocked and beaten the Act 6 of the story the Legend Stage is from.
As of now, all of the Legend Stages are designed to provide evolution materials for newer characters. Additionally, certain Legend Stages provide crafting materials for Relics.
Ex: You need Soul (Wes) item from Karakora Town you would need to previously have beaten Hollow World Act 6 to unlock this legend stage.

Passive
Slim Down - Every time Legendary Assassin (Prime) attacks, he increases his damage by 0.8% maxing at 200%. Every other upgrade changes the value of increase, up to a max of 2% per attack. Once he reaches 100%, another 100% will be added to his damage and his model will change into a slimmer version of himself, representing Legendary Assassin (Prime) in his prime.

Trivia
This unit currently deals 2x its displayed damage at upgrade 6-7.
When applying a damage buff to him, only his base damage will be affected. This means that even at maximum passive ( Slim Down ), only one-third of his displayed damage will be buffed, rather than his total damage.
His shiny skin is based on a version of Sakamoto in a flashback to before he met his wife, and was still in his "Prime". This skin is seemingly unaffected by the Slim Down passive's change of model at max efficiency.
The most efficient way to max out the damage gained by the Slim Down passive is by stopping at Upgrade 6; No Refunds, as it buffs his damage by 1.8% every 5 seconds, as compared to Upgrade 8; Slim Down's increase of 2% every 7.8 seconds, making Upgrade 6 44% faster than Upgrade 8, assuming enemies are perpetually within this unit's range.

articles.text:
- Collect Battlepass points by killing enemies in any game mode!
- Purchase a Premium Pass for Exclusive rewards!
★ All previous rewards are automatically claimed on purchase!
The Battlepass has 50 tiers with the later half opening up after a week of release; a free and premium version. Each tier starts at 50 Battlepass points, going up to 1500 Battlepass points per tier which are obtained by killing enemies that can drop between 4 and 15 Battlepass points in any game mode.
Each tier can offers the player Gems Gems, Gold, Reroll Tokens, Cursed Fingers, Star Capsules, Emotes, and exclusive units, with the premium version providing extra items and shiny units.
The premium pass can be purchased for R$799. Skip 10 levels can be purchased for R$999. Both are giftable and tradable.

Active Ability: Scramble
Operator (ROOM) has an ability called "Scramble" that teleports enemies back 50% of Lao's Range. This scales with his range, so the more range Operator (ROOM) has, the further back the enemies are teleported. For example, if he has 10 Range, Scramble will teleport enemies 5 'range' backwards on the Path. Scramble works on all enemies in his range, including Bosses.
Global Cooldown: 75s
This ability wont work on enemies that have already been affected by Scramble 3 times.

articles.title: Powerups
articles.text:
Powerups refer to ways to further enhance your units and make them even stronger.
Stat Rerolling
Curses
Limit Breaking
Stat Rerolling, added in Update 11, is a way to increase the base stats of any unit by using Stat Cubes or Perfect Stat Cubes to Reroll Stat Rerolls. You may get a worse base stat or a better base stat.
Requirements
To reroll a unit's base stat, you need at least one Stat Cube
or Perfect Stat Cube
which can be obtained from Evolving units, the Battlepass, Daily Challenges and Infinity Mansion Rewards.
Rerolling and Worthiness
Talk to the Cosmic Cat NPC (found at the Traits and Evolve area) and select "Reroll Potential". A menu will appear which will allow you to select any of your units and displays their current stats and Worthiness. (Do note that the selected unit will be automatically unequipped if previously equipped.)
Worthiness is calculated based on takedowns on a unit, every 100 takedowns adds 1% Worthiness, so a unit must have 10,000 takedowns to get 100% Worthiness.
It's always recommended to bring a unit's Worthiness to atleast 100% before rerolling any or all stats for a unit because you will have a higher chance to receive a good stat/stats such as a S.
Worthiness can go up to 400% however each reroll uses a maximum of 100%
Stat Cube
s will reroll ALL of a units stats, while as Perfect Stat Cube
s will only reroll the selected stat.
Evolution
When Evolving a unit, the stats of the unit will ALWAYS* be better than what it had when unevolved. So it is recommended to always reroll the Stats of your unit with high (preferably 100%) worthiness before evolving them. Note that the higher the %, the increase it will get may be less.
Unevolved units with a SSS stat on them will NOT benefit from this, the % will stay the same.
Stat Transfer
You can transfer the stats of one unit to another by talking to Wish Girl (found at the Play area, next to the Kizzua NPC), and stat transfer attempts costs 5000 Gold each stat. The transfer has a 50% chance of succeeding regardless of what unit in question it is, however the unit that the transferred stat originated from will be deleted 100% OF THE TIME.

Curses, added in Update 6.5, are a way to increase the stats of any unit at the cost of another stat. Are you willing to sacrifice something?
Requirement
To curse a unit, you need at least one cursed Token which can be obtained from the Cursed Womb dungeon or Battlepass . To enter the Cursed Womb dungeon, you need a Cursed Womb key which can be dropped from secret enemies that spawn in Cursed Academy Infinite.
Where to curse units
After you've received your first Cursed Finger, click/tap on it in your Items and you'll be brought to Sukuno's domain.
Curses can NOT be removed, curse your units wisely.

Notes
Curses can affect ability cooldowns, such as Commander's and Wind Dragon's.
This is crucial to being able to perform the "infinite buff" with their abilities.
Although Arlem's SPA cannot be effected through Stats or Traits, it can be affected by curses.
"A spark of divinity, forged to awaken inner power."
Limit Breaking, added in Update 19 is a mechanic that allows players to further increase the levels of their units, as well as providing a buff to their other equipped units.
In order to Limit Break a unit, you must have a Divine Wish and 12 unevolved towers of mythic/secret rarity, evolved mythics/secrets will count for double, only needing 6 total. You can fuse them together at the limit breaker located just outside of Evolution. After selecting the unit you want to Limit Break, select the sacrificial units, and then click limit break. All the units that you use for this process must be unlocked first.
Limit Breaking a unit increases its max level by 10, up to a current maximum of 110. This provides approximately a 19% increase to the towers damage. Increasing a towers levels do not change its other stats such as range or spa.
For every Limit Broken unit equipped by a player, all towers on that players team gain a stacking 5% damage buff. This buff is indicated by a small Divine Wish icon to the right of your units on your UI. You can have up to 6 Limit Broken units equipped at once, providing up to a 30% increase in damage for all of your units. Limit Breaking does not provide a buff to units owned by other players.
Divine Wish
The only current ways to obtain Divine Wishes is through Level Milestones at level 100 and through Daily Challenges. Daily Challenges have a guaranteed chance of giving one Divine Wish.
The maximum amount of Divine Wishes you can have at one time is 3.

articles.title: Quests
articles.text:
Page will be continue after the wiki revamp
Quests is an openable Interface that can be used to review the Player's unfinished Quests.
Every day, you can earn up to 3,000 Gems3,000 Gems from daily quests! This is one of the easiest and fastest ways to get gems so far. Key word being easiest there are other ways to get gems that are hard, but this method is the easiest if you do not own a macro software.
Information
Quests are separated into 4 different Categories. Event, Daily, Infinite, and Story quests.
Daily quests are quests that are granted every 24 hours. These quests are randomized for everyone and give Gems as a reward for completing them. Completing all daily quests will earn you Battle pass XP and Event Tokens. Daily quests reset after 24 hours. After Update 16 - Overlord Update, it gives 900 pearls as Event Tokens.
Event quests are quests that are granted during an Event.
Story quests are the Player's World quests. These can be completed from time to time as you progress further through the Story. Each Act will earn you 80 Gems80 Gems + 50 Level XP if it's a first time clear, otherwise you'll earn 20 Gems20 Gems and 50 Level XP for clear.
Infinite quests are the players random daily Infinite quests. they are a re-vamp of the daily infinite mode rewards and were added in update 7.00. These quests are randomized for 3 maps and give Gems as a reward for completing them. They reset after 24 hours.

articles.title: Relic Shards
articles.text:
Relic Shards are a rare material used to craft Relics.
They can currently only be obtained from the newest raid stages. These are:
Sacred Planet Stage 4 (The Genie) (10% Chance), and Sacred Planet Stage 5 (The Pure Form) (Guaranteed).
They are currently used to craft the Mangekyō Eye, the Mirrorblade, and the Endless Blades.
Trivia
They also appear to be very similar to Cookie Run: Kingdom's "Purity Crystals".

articles.title: Relics
articles.text:
Overview
Relics were introduced in Update 7 alongside the new damage types, and can heavily boost a unit's damage or usability if used correctly.
Buff Types
% DMG : Increases the damage of units of that type by a percentage.
PEN: Penetrates through resistances of enemies.
Resistance reduces damage by 100 / (100 + Resistance). So an enemy with 150 Magic Resistance will only take 40% Magic Damage.
PWR: Increases DPS/Upgrade. Scales with unit level. The amount will change if you equip it to a unit (to reflect the unit level scaling).

articles.title: Secret Portal
articles.text:
Secret Portals
Secret Portals are limited time portals that drop Special Units. They hold up to 6 players. Secret portals have a slight chance of appearing as a reward for completing their respective portals, such as the Frost Queen's Portal dropping after completing a Frozen Portal.
Obtainable Secret Portals

articles.title: Summon
articles.text:
Legacy Banner
Summon is an area in the lobby where players can obtain powerful characters to aid them in the completion of Levels. It is located to the left of the Leaderboard area. Please note that not every MythicalMythical can be viably used in later stages. If you've saved up gems, it's suggested to find a video showcasing of a unit before attempting to spin for it on the unit banner.
Legacy Banner
Each summon will cost you 50 Gems Gems (40 Gems Gems with the VIP Gamepass) or a Summon Ticket. Every hour the banner will be refreshed with random units, with 3 MythicalMythical units being featured.
(Legacy gems are required for this banner, which can be obtained by either converting regular gems, or by disenchanting certain units.)
The summoning rates for this banner are similar to the Special Banner, however each individual unfeatured MythicalMythical will have a SLIGHTLY higher chance to be summoned (0.714% vs 0.625% out of the 0.5% mythic chance), due to the units from Update 19 and onwards not being present in this banner.
Summoning builds up Pity bar for middle unit; with each summon, you will accumulate 1/400 in pity bar for MythicalMythical Pity. Accumulating 400 pulls will grant you a guaranteed MythicalMythical featured middle unit.
Pulling a MythicalMythical character at any point whilst summoning will reset the corresponding Pity back to 0. Pity will also reset once the banner has refreshed.
Special Banner
Special Banner
Since Update 7, The Special Banner can summon any unit in the game, excluding those obtainable through other means, and other banners. The chances of getting a MythicalMythical unit are 0.5%. As opposed to the Legacy Banner, units from Update 19 and onwards are obtainable from this banner.
Three Mythics will be featured. The center MythicalMythical has a 50% chance of being the summoned MythicalMythical. The Mythics beside it have a 10% chance, and any unfeatured MythicalMythical has a 0.526% chance. Just like the standard banner, the featured Mythics are refreshed every hour.
Since Update 17, all MythicalMythical units from Release to Update 6.5 have been removed from the Special Banner. As of Update 19, however, they have been added back to this banner.
Like Legacy Banner, there is also a pity for middle featured unit to guarantee summoned after 400 pulls, which cost total of 20,000 Gems20,000 Gems ( 16,000 Gems16,000 Gems if owned VIP gamepass)

Event Banner
Event Banner
Since Update 13.5, limited-time MythicalMythical units can be summoned from the Event Banner. The chance to obtain a Mythic is 0.5%, similar to the special banner. However, only 3 limited-time MythicalMythical units are featured, with no other MythicalMythical units being obtainable from this banner. Units on the Event Banner can only be summoned using a limited-time currency, typically obtained from the current event.
The MythicalMythical units featured are constant, and the banner does not refresh every hour; the featured units stay from the beginning to the end of the event. They will instead be replaced by new event MythicalMythical units from future events. MythicalMythical Pity can be achieved by summoning 200 times. Unowned MythicalMythical units are prioritized by the Pity, until all featured Mythics are obtained. It costs a total of 2000 event currency to get the MythicalMythical Pity for the current event.
Legendary pity is not included in this banner.
Summon Chance
Every single unit has the same chance of being obtained from a Summon according to their Rarity. Below are the chances for each Rarity:
Rare = 81.9% / Shiny Rare: 0.819% chance of dropping (2.457% with shiny hunter).
Epic = 16% / Shiny Epic: 0.16% chance of dropping (0.48% with shiny hunter).
Legendary = 2% / Shiny Legendary: 0.02% chance of dropping (0.06% with shiny hunter).
MythicalMythical = 0.25% / Shiny MythicalMythical: 0.0025% chance of dropping (0.0075% with shiny hunter).
MythicalMythical from the Special Banner = 0.5% / Shiny MythicalMythical: 0.005% chance of dropping (0.015% with shiny hunter).
MythicalMythical from the Event Banner = 0.5% / Shiny MythicalMythical: 0.005% chance of dropping (0.015% with shiny hunter). (Same as special.)
Secret = 1/400,000 chance / Shiny Secret = ??? (estimated to be around 0.005% chance for non-shinies)
All summoned unit has 1% chance to be Shiny version (3% if obtained Shiny Hunter gamepass)
Secret (Normal and Shiny) and Shiny MythicalMythical units are known to be very rare. Whenever somebody summons one in any server, it is announced in the Roblox chat globally.
Consuming a Luck Potion will increase the odds of obtaining an Epic, Legendary, or MythicalMythical, but will NOT reduce the pity.
In the banner window, extra potent luck potions can be purchased for Robux. These potions increase the odds of obtaining Legendary and MythicalMythical summons. The Super Lucky potion costs 99 Robux and increases odds for said rarities by 2x. The Ultra Lucky potion costs 149 Robux and increases odds for said rarities by 3x.
These buffs DO stack and using a Luck, Super Lucky, and Ultra Lucky all at once, will set the MythicalMythical chance to 0.936%.
Luck Potion does not shows to affect on Event Banner.
Banner Tiers
Banner Tiers are a mechanic released in Update 1.5 to make it so that newer players aren't able to roll for certain types of units. This is to make sure late-game players can't make alt accounts to pull better and stronger Units.
Tier 0 (Player Level 0+): Can't summon Secret units or shinies.
Tier 1 (Player Level 5+): Can summon shinies but not Secret units.
Tier 2 (Player Level 20+): Can summon Secret units and shinies.
Trivia
Since the Halloween 2022 update, if anyone pulls a Shiny MythicalMythical or a Secret, it announces it in chat for everyone playing to see.
Since update 20.4.1, secret chance has been revealed to be 1/400,000 chance, however it does not have a pity.
Along with all banner has been added pity chance for middle unit after 200 times summon.
Legendary pity has also been removed, replace with MythicalMythical pity with 400 pulls.

Attacks starting from Upgrade 7 are able to hit air type enemies.
Passive Ability: Shade Birth
Summons a Shade Birth after taking down 10 enemies (max 3), the Shade Birth will have 5x of his displayed damage.
Zombie (Risen) increases the amount of HP the Shade Birth spawns in by 25% of each placement (up to 200%). Buffs to Supreme Being (Sovereign) by Elfy (Slyph), Wind Dragon or Idol, do not affect the amount of HP the Shade Birth spawns with.
Griffin (Reincarnation) and Commander increase the amount of damage Shade Birth does when colliding with an enemy.
You can increase the damage the Shade Birth does by increasing Supreme Being (Sovereign)'s base damage stats: having high stat potential, Traits that increase damage and Relics.
Shade Birth does not do Dark damage like Supreme Being (Sovereign), instead only doing physical.
Active Ability: Nihilism
Once Activated, a 12-second interval will appear above Supreme Being (Sovereign), once the time ticks down to zero, any enemy in the range of Supreme Being will take 5x of his damage, enemies who are caught by this also have a purple effect around them.
Selling
Unit sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
Trivia
He is the second Secret unit added in the game that is not limited-time. The first unit being Lulu.
In the winter event his Shade Births have a spawn cap of 3 per path and thus can have 9 of them at the same time.
Before update 18.5, he need at least 50 kills in order to summon a Shade Birth. From update 19.0, his passive requirement has been buff with only required 1 kill in order to summon.
However from update 19.5, he has received a nerf, making his kill requirement into 10 kills in order to summon.

articles.title: Terminology
articles.text:
This page will list the terms/slang and abbreviations used on certain pages, or just used by community a lot in general.
Terms & Abbreviations
AA - Anime Adventures
An abbreviation for the name of the game.
DPS - Damage Per Second
A calculation of how much damage a unit could theoretically do in 1 second, calculated using {Damage/SPA = DPS}.
SPA - Second Per Attack
Alternatively, "Attack speed", or how long it will take for a unit to attack.
CD - Cooldown
Short for the amount of time it takes an ability to refresh.
AoE - Area of Effect
AoE (Cone) - Attacks with an AoE that resembles a cone. Any enemies within the cone will get damaged.
AoE (Circle) - Attacks with an AoE that resembles a circle . Any enemies within the circle will get damaged.
AoE (Line) - Attacks with an AoE that resembles a line. Any enemies within the line will get damaged.
AoE (Full) - Attacks within said unit's range bubble. Any enemies within the bubble will get damaged.
META - Most Effective Tactic Available
The strongest units/lineup/placements a Player can use or have. To check a unit's viability, visit the Tier Lists page.
RND - Random
Short for Random. Commonly used as a term for a Unit's stats. Why Random? Refer to the FAQ page.
Inf - Infinite
Short for the Infinite Gamemode.
LB - Leaderboard
Short for the Leaderboards in the Lobby.
TS - Timestop
Short for Timestop, an ability usable by certain Units.
TA - Time Acceleration
Short for Time Accel/Acceleration. Priest (Heaven)'s Ability.
RR - Reroll
Short for Reroll Tokens, which is the tokens used for rerolling units's traits (not to be confused with Star Remnants) . It's also a tradable item, and can be used as the base trading value for units/items/...
LF/MLF/NLF - Looking for/Mainly Looking For/Not Looking For
Mainly used in trading to discuss what a trader wants. *Could also be used as "Might Look For"
SAO - Sword Art Online
Used to refer to the map "Virtual Dungeon".

Information
This page classifies different units to different ranks depending on how good they are in most modes. DPS is the main factor in this list, although all aspects are considered such as SPA, AoE, Range, Placement, Etc. Keep in mind that the rankings are not completely indicative of a units' power - some may be better or worse in certain maps or gamemodes.
For the Infinity Castle Tier List, go here.
This tier list does not include units when paired with certain traits, relics, other units, etc.
Disclaimer: Given it's a community-based Tier List, any vandalism will be not tolerated and will be given a harsher sentence accordingly.
