This page is not completely updated and may be inaccurate.
Information
This page classifies different units to different ranks depending on how good they are in Infinite Mode and Casual Modes (Story/Raids/Portals/Stages).
TIER LIST WILL BE UPDATED SOON WHEN WIKI REVAMP IS COMPLETE
Units are ranked based on the following statistics:
DPS(Damage Per Second)
TDPS(Total Damage Per Second)
SPA(Second Per Attack)
AoE(Area of Effect)
(as well as many other properties of a unit; Cost, Abilities, Effects, etc)
The ranking of each unit does not invalidate the unit in other modes, some may be better or worse in certain stages, maps, or gamemodes. This tier list ranks units based on their base stats, and their potential including buffs, supports, and relics, however, disregards trait viability.
For a community-based Tier List, go here.
For the Infinity Castle Tier List, go here.

articles.title: Time Machine
articles.text:
Contents
1 Overview
2 Tips
3 Gems
4 Trivia
Overview
The Time Machine is a landmark located in the Lobby. Entering it will teleport you out of the main experience to AFK for gems. AFKing will grant the normal Player +3 Gems every 150 seconds, and players with VIP or Roblox Premium will be granted +6 Gems every 150 seconds. As of Update 19.5, the Time Machine is currently disabled.
Tips
VIP and Roblox's Premium subscriptions do stack with each other.
AFKing in here is one of the best ways to gain lots of gems when you're away from your device. Using a macro software such as TinyTask to prevent disconnecting and perform infinite runs will let you gain more gems per session.
Recommended to participate with caution as AFKing for a long time could lead to your PC/mobile device overheating and possibly shutting off.
The only way to save your gems is to click "leave and claim reward". If you get kicked out while you're in the Time Machine, it will save your gems, but closing Roblox manually won't.

articles.title: Time Traveller's Shard
articles.text:
The Time Traveller Shard.
The Time Traveler Shard is a Secret Limited item that was added in the 13.5 Update. It is received by completing tier 5 or above Witch Portals with a small drop chance. It is used to create the Secret Portal, Witch City (Walpurges), which guarantees the host Homuru. You need 4 shards to create the secret portal.
Trivia
Remember to make sure when crafting the portal that you don't have all portal slots full. The portal has a chance of being lost if all slots are full. Make sure you have 199/200 portals or fewer.
The drop chance is estimated to be around 3%. Up until the summer update, the drop rate of Time Traveler Shard was increased by 50%,from 3% to 4.5%.
It is believed to be that drop chance does not scale with the difficulty of the portal.

articles.text:
(Trading Button)
Trading is a feature that got added in Update 6. The requirements to trade is level 40. Currently, you can trade unit skins and units. As of Update 8 you are only able to trade Limited units, along with unit skins and some relics. Here are some Trading info you may use while Trading. small add = 5-50 add normal add = 50-100 big add = 100-200 huge add = 200-500 massive add = 500+ and above

articles.title: Traits
articles.text:
Traits are modifiers that boost unit’s stats (Damage, SPA & Range). When you summon a unit or obtain it from a portal, it might come with a trait. Additionally, you can reroll traits through the use ofStar Remnants or Reroll Tokens.
Rerolling Traits
To reroll traits, interact with Ethereal Guide, who is outside the Evolve area in the lobby (can be teleported to by using Traits and Evolve shortcut). Currently, there are two ways to reroll a trait: usingStar Remnants or Reroll Tokens.
Star Remnants can be obtained from the Travelling Merchant Shop, by completing Daily Challenges, from removing Shinies (by interacting with Lucil in the lobby), by defeating a Star Golem in latest Infinite Mode, or a 0.25% chance from summons. If the player is usingStar Remnants to reroll a trait, the amount required depends on the unit the trait is being rerolled on:
MythicalMythical and Secret units require 5Star Remnants per reroll,
Rare, Epic and Legendary units require 1Star Remnant per reroll.
Reroll Tokens can be obtained from Battlepasses, Evolution Quests or other events. Any unit will require only 1Reroll Token per roll.Reroll Tokens can be also bought:
1Reroll Token for 129 R$ ($1.62 USD)
10Reroll Tokens for 999 R$ ($12.49 USD)
50Reroll Tokens for 4500 R$ ($56.25 USD)
List of Traits
Trait
Description
Superior
29.97%
Units with this trait do increased Damage to enemies.
Superior I increases Damage by 10%
Superior II increases Damage by 12.5%
Superior III increases Damage by 15%.
Superior I/II/III increases average DPS by 10/12.5/15% respectively.
Nimble
24.98%
Units with this trait have their SPA decreased, which allows them to attack more frequently.
Nimble I decreases SPA by 5%
Nimble II decreases SPA by 7.5%,
Nimble III decreases SPA by 12%.
Nimble I/II/III increases average DPS by 5.2/8.1/13.6% respectively.
Range
24.98%
Units with this trait have increased Range, which allows their attacks to reach more enemies.
Range I increases Range by 10%
Range II increases Range by 12.5%,
Range III increases Range by 15%.
Range I/II/III does not increase average DPS if the unit can always reach enemies.
Adept
9.99%
Units with this Trait level up at a faster rate, receiving 50% more XP. This trait is good for leveling up low-level units.
Adept does not increase DPS.
Culling
5%
Units with this trait have a 20% Damage boost to enemies with 30% or lower health.
Culling increases average DPS for units by 20% to enemies with under 30% health or lower, averaging to 6% increase.
Sniper
2.5%
Units with this trait receive a 25% Range boost.
This trait is ideal for units like Operator (ROOM), Shadowgirl (Time Traveller), Commander, Wind Dragon or Elfy (Sylph), since their ability can affect more enemies, units, or have a stronger impact.
Sniper does not increase average DPS if the unit can always reach enemies.
Godspeed
1%
Units with this trait receive a 20% SPA reduction, significantly increasing attack frequency.
Ideal for slow units such as Gene (???), Mimic Sorcerer (Cursed Child), Jackal (Alpha), Illusionist (Final), Hammer Giantess (Creation), Ice Queen (Empire's Strongest), Millie (Holy), Golden Tyrant (Emperor) ,Frost Navy (Blue Pigeon) and Reliable Student (Echoes).
This trait gives your unit a blue lightning aura.
Godspeed increases average DPS by 25%.
Reaper
0.8%
Units with this trait do 15% more Damage and deal 25% more Damage to bosses.
Good trait for units that work well against bosses like Captain (God) and Curse (Contract).
This trait gives your unit a red and blackish aura.
Reaper increases average DPS by 15% normally, and by 43.75% when damaging a boss.
Celestial
0.36%
Units with this trait have a 10% Damage boost, a 10% Range boost and a 20% Damage Buff as True Damage (With 100% buff from Leafy/Wenda/Orwin the bonus is reduced to 10% Damage Buff as True Damage, but 200% buff with Griffin (Reincarnation) included, it is reduced to 13.3% Damage Buff as True Damage, with just griff the true damage buff is still 20% since griff buffs all dmg types.[1]
Units that inflict DoT (Damage Over Time, e.g. Bleed) with trait does 20% more DoT damage, due to its base DoT dmg already scaling from the combined sum of its total dmg (Dmg + True dmg), and also adding an extra 20% true damage from celestial
Good for Infinity Mansion, Legend Stages, Daily Challenges or any mode that has enemies with resistances.
This trait gives your unit a purple galaxy aura.
Celestial increases average DPS by 32%
Divine
0.2%
Units with this trait have a 20% Damage boost, 10% SPA reduction, and a 20% Range boost.
Ideal trait for:
Units with 4+ spawn cap, like Joykid (Mode IV), Gamer (Dual) or Hammerhead (Shark Empress);
Support units that benefit from multiple placements, like Shinobi (Eternal);
Units that need multiple placements for the best effect, like Griffin (Ascension).
This trait gives your unit angelic wings.
Divine increases average DPS by 33.3%.
Golden
0.15%
Units with this trait have a 30% Damage boost and receive 20% more Yen each time they make money.
Ideal trait for farm units Bulby and C.E.O.. Note that while Weather Girl (Thief) being a farm unit, Golden only gives her a 30% Damage boost, but not a Yen boost.
This trait gives your unit a golden appearance.
Golden increases average DPS by 30%.
Unique
0.1%
Units with this Trait have a 4x (300%) Damage boost, 10% SPA reduction, and a 10% Range boost. Units with this trait are restricted to a maximum of ONE of this unit placed (only affects the owner of the unit).
Ideal trait for units with 3 placements, like Illusionist (Final), Priest (Heaven), Hubris (The One), Berserker (Rage), Tango (Flash God), Stringy (Awakened) or Sea God (Tyrant of the Seas).
Perfect trait for units with high individual DPS but low (1 - 2) placement cap, like JIO (Over Heaven), Iron Knight (Arsenal), Usurper (Founder), Time Wizard (Chronos), Skeleton Knight (King), Illusionist (Transcended) or Supreme Being (Sovereign). These units can even outperform their 3 placements counterparts.
Although units with 4+ placements have either a weak group DPS increase or even a DPS decrease, it can still be a useful trait for progressive gamemode due to being 4+ times cheaper to max.
This trait gives your unit an enchanting aura adorned with ancient runic symbols.
Unique increases average DPS by 344.4% for a single unit. Group average DPS increase depends on unit's placement cap.

Trivia
When evolving a Legendary unit to MythicalMythical, its trait will be transfered. Therefore, rolling a trait on its Legendary form will be 5 times cheaper.
Units that can benefit from this are Fox Ninja (Beast Cloak), Usurper, Martial Demon, Gene, Experiment X (Semi-Perfect).
Although Superior, Nimble and Range are Rare traits, their third variant (III) has an Epic rarity, indicated by a purple trait symbol and label.
There is a 0.2% chance that you can receive double trait on one unit while rerolling traits.
When this happens, total percentage boost of two traits will be added.
Double Superior III would give a 30% Damage boost.
Double Unique would give a 600% Damage boost, 20% SPA reduction, and a 20% Range boost.
Newly obtained units have a 1% chance to gain a trait. If successful, there is a further 1% chance to gain double traits.
Unique can make some units as good or better than some Meta units.
Culling, despite being a Legendary trait, has a very weak effect, barely outperforming Superior I (on average).
In most circumstances, Reaper is equivalent to Superior III.
While Range boosts do not affect unit's Damage or SPA, with the right placement units with traits that boost Range might have more opportunity for attacking, thus increasing average DPS.
Golden is the only trait that effects farm units such as C.E.O. and Bulby, giving 20% more gold each wave.

articles.title: Traits Tier List
articles.text:
Traits
Traits are one of the most common modifiers to a units viability. They can range from giving a unit a boost to their three core base stats, to allowing them to gain more money or inflict more damage upon certain enemies.
Traits can be applied to units via. Wis who stands outside of the evolution area in the main lobby. Star Remnants can be collected via. Bulmy's shop, challenges, capsules, and many other methods. 5 star remnants are required to spin a trait onto a mythic or secret unit, while only 1 is required for any unit under that rarity level. Trait reroll tokens on the other hand only require one of themselves to spin a trait on a unit of any rarity. They can be traded for, aquired through the pass, or bought with Robux.
Unique and Divine are both the best trait in the game, Unique is better for units for less than 4 placements and Divine is better for 4 or more.

articles.text:
THE UNIT LIST WILL BE UPDATED ONCE THE WIKI REVAMP IS COMPLETE, AS WE ARE STILL AWAITING UNIT DATA FROM THE DEVELOPERS.
Units are the primary way to defend against oncoming enemies. These are very vital to the Player's gameplay as they help progress further into the game.
Most Units are offensive ones, either placed on the ground, on the hill, or they can be both, however, some can provide support in its own way, such as buffing other towers, debuffing enemies and spawning units. Each have their own special ability and can be extremely powerful when paired with other Units. Units can also go through Evolution, which further strengthen the Unit's base stats and even give them new abilities.

Passive Ability: Spellforged Blades
Attacks from Vengeful Swordsman (Sky Reaver) also deal his damage as additional Magic damage. Buffs to Physical damage apply to his Magic damage as well.
This means he does x2 his displayed damage
Passive Ability: White Flash Draw Technique
The first hit against an enemy will have + 100% Critical Chance and penetrate 60% of enemy Physical and Magic Resistances (If they have ones)
Selling
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
Trivia
Despite stating to penetrate 60% of Physical and Magic Resistances it has been proven he only penetrates 40%
Its possible get a Double Crit in his first hit (x2.5 instead of x1.5) if you have a base crit chance.
Gambler (Jackpot) gives both types of Crit Chance (magic and physical) to Vengeful Swordsman (Sky Reaver)
For some reason is impossible to get a Double Magic Crit despite Vengeful Swordsman (Sky Reaver) having a base magic Crit Chance
Vengeful Swordsman (Sky Reaver) can be buffed by Elfy (Sylph) or Wind Dragon and Commander at the same time, however, elfy or wind dragon will only buff his Magic damage.

Active Ability: Sky Enchantment
Sky Enchantment is available upon placement. When activated, Wenda increases the magical damage stats of units in her range by 30%. The buff lasts for 30 seconds and the ability has a cooldown of 60 seconds. When correctly placed down and timed correctly, she can buff units by 100%.
"Infinite" Buff Guide
Wind Dragon MUST BE CURSED with +SPA curse in order for this to work. ATTACK SPEED FROM STATS DO NOT MATTER AND DO NOT AFFECT ABILITY COOLDOWN.
The percent shouldn't really matter, but depending on how high or low the increase might effect how long the loop will last. (Not exactly sure on the specifics yet.)
Guide:
1. Place 4 Wind Dragon's, doesn't really matter the position as long as all they are all in each others range.
2. Activate the first Wind Dragon's ability, then wait 4-5 seconds. (Using an auto-clicker set to a 4-5 second interval can help if you are having trouble timing it.)
3. Activate a second Wind Dragon's ability. Then wait for the 25% buff to disappear.
4. As soon as the 30% disappears, immediately activate your third Wind Dragon's ability, then wait until the 69% buff to disappear.
5. As soon as the 69% disappears, immediately activate the your fourth Wind Dragon's ability.
After this they should all loop 100% for a while, this loop isn't truly infinite since over time the ability will slowly desync, but if timed right can last for over 50 rounds, which is long enough for pretty much every situation.
Selling
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
Trivia
Before Update 7.6.0 (Karakora Town Event Part 2), she was a ground unit, meaning she could not be deployed on hill areas.
Before Update 12.0.0 (Cloud Hunt), her damage wasn't going up from her upgrades. As of this update, she currently has the highest DPS of all Legendary tier units in the game, as her DPS on max upgrade is just as the same as Devil Boss on his max upgrade.
Before Update 14.0.0 (Sword Art Online):
Her spawn cap was 3. Now it's 6, and global.
Chaining her buffs allows her to buff all magic units by 100%, although to consistently do this you may need to apply curses to her SPA to get this to a full uptime, this also applies to Commander

Passive:Undead Blessing
Zombie (Risen) provides a buff to all summons spawned on the map. This buff increases the damage dealt by summons and the range of summons by +25% dmg and +10% range for each Zombie (Risen) placed on the map. The damage bonus is capped at 8 placements (+200% dmg (3x), +80% rng (1.8x). The buff stacks multiplicatively with other buffers such as Commander, Wind Dragon, and Griffin (Reincarnation).
